title: Nigeria SEC — transport provenance/type without changing the selected numeric measure

code_path_finding.extractor: sec_ng_nav_extractor_v6.py exports source_url, source metadata, vl_price_source, currency evidence and quality_flags.
code_path_finding.importer: scripts/import/import_vl_nigeria_sec.js currently discards source/type fields while grouping rows before vl_contract.validate().
code_path_finding.contract: src/lib/vl_contract.js already stores source_url/price_type/data_quality/batch but currently considers any recognized BID/OFFER/UNIT_PRICE/NAV_TOTAL explicit type sufficient for OK if other checks pass.
code_path_finding.doctrine: Extractor comments explicitly state Unit Price is the VL; Bid/Offer are fallback prices and must be named so downstream can reject/review knowingly.

target_behavior.numeric_value: UNCHANGED in first rollout. Continue using the same selected vl_price so this lot cannot silently alter NAV history.
target_behavior.currency: UNCHANGED in first rollout; existing CURRENCY_MISMATCH rejection remains.
target_behavior.source_url: Transport exact extractor source_url to canonical contract.

data_quality_policy.UNIT_PRICE: Existing validation may yield OK when currency/provenance also conform.
data_quality_policy.OFFER: REVIEW — explicit fallback, never automatically upgraded to OK.
data_quality_policy.BID: REVIEW — explicit fallback, never automatically upgraded to OK.
data_quality_policy.NAV_TOTAL: REVIEW unless a separate business rule proves it is the intended canonical measurement for that dataset.

target_behavior.report_date: NULL unless an actual published/report date is exported; valuation_date must not be repurposed.
target_behavior.sec_document_id: NULL unless a real official identifier is available.
target_behavior.quality_flags: Preserve through lineage/audit when generic lineage link exists; at minimum use fallback flags to prevent OK classification.

touched_surfaces_candidate: new focused importer metadata fixture/test if needed
exact_sequence: Add pure normalization helper for extractor vl_price_source -> contract price_type.
Extend vl_contract validation tests so BID/OFFER fallback yields REVIEW in warn mode and remains accepted but never OK.
Transport source_url and normalized price_type through importer grouping without changing vl_price/currency/fund matching.
Dry-run current sec_ng_latest.csv before/after: numeric selected values, fund matches, currency and row counts must be identical.
Assert 8627 current rows become provenance-present but fallback-review, not OK.
Deploy code only through existing governed path after task promotion; observe next scheduled Nigeria cycle.
Historical metadata backfill, if useful, is a separate task from retained artifacts and exact identity.

acceptance_criteria: Zero numeric VL difference for identical input CSV.
Zero change to fund matching and selected currency.
Offer/Bid fallbacks are explicit REVIEW, never silently OK.
Current strict/warn deployment semantics remain compatible.
AF-OPS-007 C7/C3 remains open until numeric scale/currency issues are independently resolved.
non_goals: Does not solve C7/C3 by itself.
Does not decide whether Offer should remain canonical value long term.
Does not mutate historical database rows.
Does not create a new Nigeria pipeline.
blocker: Current operational tasks are read-only preflight/RCA and AF-TASK-028 claims task-queue.json. Promote only when governance permits.
next_action: Attach this proposal to the existing DATA_QUALITY/pipeline program after queue release; start RED tests and dry-run, not production writes.
